Rehearse the handover of an AI application

Ask your own operator to deploy, diagnose and roll back the application while the delivery team observes.

Worked example

Pick a staging service your team will inherit. Give an operator the runbook and a clean account with the permissions their job will actually have. The vendor can observe and take notes. Every time the operator needs an undocumented command, credential or decision, record the missing instruction.

Worksheet
ExerciseEvidence of a usable handover
Deploy a small changeThe operator finds the repository, identifies the running revision and deploys an approved change to staging using a company-owned account.
Find a failed jobGive the operator a request ID. They find the relevant logs, identify the failing dependency and locate the escalation contact.
Roll backThe operator restores the previous release and checks a user-visible result. Record separately how to recover any data changed since deployment.
Remove vendor accessList vendor identities, scheduled jobs and shared credentials. Revoke a test identity and confirm the application still completes its normal workflow.

Agree on the last support payment

Put the rehearsal date, operator name and open items in the handover record. Give each open item an owner and a retest date. Repeat the failed exercise with the updated instructions before signing acceptance.
